subject: world_language
concept: Agreeing and disagreeing politely in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'agree/disagree' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student responds to a stated opinion with polite agreement or disagreement in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an agree/disagree phrase to the correct social tone (polite vs. rude)
exercise.abstract: Student writes a polite disagreement response to a given opinion

misconception_flags: uses an overly blunt or impolite disagreement structure in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
